subject: Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance
overview: The Council approved the first reading of a divestment ordinance targeting fossil fuels and weapons manufacturers, and passed a resolution seeking to extend the city's zoning reform timeline with a $200,000 funding request for public outreach.

items.title: Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from July 15 and committee reports regarding the tree committee ordinance and the Tufts Institutional Zone framework.

items.title: Petition for Common Victualler's License: CB Scoops
items.summary: Tabled the petition for a license at 53 High Street because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Municipal Preliminary Election Warrants
items.summary: Approved the call and warrant for the September 16, 2025, municipal preliminary election following a briefing on mail-in and early voting schedules.

items.title: MBTA Bus Stop Improvements
items.summary: Approved the relocation of the Tufts Garage bus stop on Boston Avenue to improve ADA accessibility near the Green Line station.

items.title: Appointment to the Garden Commission
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Mark Lalli to the Garden Commission for a term expiring in 2028.

items.title: Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an ordinance to divest city funds from companies involved in fossil fuels, private prisons, weapons manufacturing, and human rights violations. The item drew extensive public comment from residents debating the ordinance's ethical merits, financial feasibility, and potential geopolitical implications regarding Israel.

items.title: Zoning Reform Project Timeline and Funding
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing an extended timeline for residential zoning updates and requesting $200,000 from the Mayor for expanded public outreach and consultant fees. The Council also requested a public statement from the planning department to clarify which recommendations were previously adopted for the Salem Street corridor.

items.title: Tree Committee and Personnel Ordinances
items.summary: Tabled the tree committee ordinance for further legal review and approved the third reading of an amendment to the personnel ordinance concerning a civil project manager position.
